limitation: Model selection and reported performance use the same 12 origins; no independent post-selection test set. Scores are exploratory, not clinical or operational validation.
selection_rule: Lowest expanding-window one-step MAE among models completing every common origin; RMSE then predefined model order break ties; final-fit failure falls back in that order
training_window_reason: 24 quarters provide six annual cycles, with 12 common test origins. This pragmatic choice limits parameter estimation risk; it is not evidence of adequacy or validation.
